why: A single-pass hygiene run must open the body and EXACTLY the one audit-pass companion the --check slug names. Reading the body alone means the agent worked from the routing table's one-line description and never loaded the pass's goal, steps, or severity rules — the exact regression progressive disclosure risks, and one that every prose assertion in tests/ stays green through.
mustNotReadWhy: A --check run that loads other passes has lost the disclosure benefit — it is paying for all 23 to run one. Two are sampled rather than all 22; failing on the full set would make an agent that reads one extra companion look like a regression.
